questions.question: Who became the youngest Formula One Drivers' Champion in history at the age of 20?
questions.explanation: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 world title after finishing third in Mexico, setting a new record for the youngest champion.
questions.context: 2026 Formula One World Championship: In open-wheel racing, Italian driver Kimi Antonelli, driving for Mercedes, wins the Formula One World Drivers' Championship after finishing third at the Mexico City Grand Prix, becoming the youngest Drivers' Champion at the age of 20 years, 68 days.

questions.question: Protest camps in Lisbon and Porto were recently dismantled by police following demonstrations focused on which issue?
questions.explanation: Portuguese riot police broke up housing protest camps after demonstrations led to clashes and several arrests.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest > 2026 Portuguese housing protests: Portuguese riot police dismantle protest camps in Lisbon's Rossio Square and Porto, arresting 13 people for refusing orders to disperse. Thirteen officers are injured, while activists say more than 30 protesters are also injured.

questions.question: Which nation declared a national state of emergency in preparation for the upcoming peak of the super El Niño climate event?
questions.explanation: President Rodrigo Paz declared a state of emergency in Bolivia to help mobilize resources before El Niño peaks towards the end of the year.
questions.context: 2026–2027 El Niño event: Bolivian president Rodrigo Paz declares a national state of emergency to mobilize resources before the super El Niño event peaks in November or December.

questions.question: Demonstrations took place in New Delhi calling for the resignation of which major public official?
questions.explanation: Protesters demanded the stepping down of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over disputed alterations to voter registries.
questions.context: 2026 anti-CEC protests: Thousands of people protest in New Delhi, India, to call for chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign due to changes to voter lists that allegedly disproportionately affect opposition parties.

questions.question: Authorities in Bangladesh created a official wage board following demonstrations by workers in which major sector?
questions.explanation: The government established a wage review body after garment industry employees in Dhaka clashed with police over pay and living costs.
questions.context: Garment workers clash with police in Dhaka, Bangladesh, over low pay and the rising cost of living. In response, the government forms a wage board.
